code: export function heapSort(a: readonly number[]): number[] { const arr = [...a]; const n = arr.length; const siftDown = (start, end) => { let root = start; while (root * 2 + 1 <= end) { let child = root * 2 + 1; if (child + 1 <= end && arr[child] < arr[child + 1]) child += 1; if (arr[root] < arr[child]) { [arr[root], arr[child]] = [arr[child], arr[root]]; root = child; } else return; } }; for (let start = Math.floor((n - 2) / 2); start >= 0; start--) siftDown(start, n - 1); for (let end = n - 1; end > 0; end--) { [arr[0], arr[end]] = [arr[end], arr[0]]; siftDown(0, end - 1); } return arr; }
